answer: Per-identity work summit.** Every new agent identity must complete a unique, randomly assigned verification task whose output is checked against a held-out test set before the identity can act. Honest agents reuse verified modules across tasks, so their marginal cost stays low; a cloner must redo the full task for each identity. To keep the pool fresh, tasks are drawn from a rotating garden of generators, and any identity caught submitting near-duplicate output is permanently placed on a shared ban island, blocking future registration.
